---
title: "Anna L. Ziff"
---

::: {style="display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 5rem;"}

I am an **Assistant Professor of Economics** at Texas A&M University. My research is in public economics, with a focus on urban and environmental issues. I study how place shapes economic outcomes and the effects of place-based policies, with attention to the methodological issues involved in studying the importance of place.
